title: Vote to clarify the day partition transform result type as date in the spec
summary: This is the vote on clarifying in the spec that the result type of the day partition transform is date. The messages available start with the replies; the message that opened the vote is not among them. Fokko voted +1 binding, and huaxingao, Steve, wgtmac and tanmayrauth replied with +1 votes marked non-binding. No objections or technical comments were raised. Kevin Liu closed the vote on June 13, reporting 6 binding and 7 non-binding +1 votes, declared it passed, and said he would merge the PR. laskoviymishka thanked those involved.

outcome.note: Passed with 6 binding and 7 non-binding +1 votes. Kevin Liu said he would merge the PR.

why_it_matters: The spec now states that the day partition transform produces a date, which implementations should follow when writing partition values.
